title: aesyin's Cinematic Modpack
description: The Modpack used to make Minecraft look cinematic.
body:
A collection of mods that enhance and cinematise Minecraft, while keeping the vanilla aspects of the game.

This Modpack is used in aesyin's videos.

For enhancing the UI we have compact fonts, Sounds, AutoHUD, and Camera Overhaul.

For Animations we have Fresh Animations, Player Moves, Fresh Animations x BareBones.
